metadata.title: The Bond Market Is Changing Fast. Investors Need a New Playbook.<!-- --> - Barron's

The Bond Market Is Changing Fast. Investors Need a New Playbook.
The rise in U.S. Treasury yields is creating opportunities—along with serious portfolio risks.
The simple part of your portfolio is getting a lot more complicated.
